rules: Never push to main or develop directly.
The owner merges and releases; the agent only opens pull requests.
ownerActions: Merge pull requests #35 to #60 in order (each builds on the one before), then tell me "merged proceed"; I then prepare the Release 0.9.0 pull request. I never merge or tag.

Confirm my assumptions, listed in the pull requests: low stock 2 or fewer; slow mover 30+ days and under 25% sold; trend threshold 5%; markdown end date required; a return offsets only its own pay-later bill; GST rules (all unverified).
Take every GST rule to your CA before switching GST on (Settings, GST, owner only). It is off by default.

Decide what bills and hangtags should say until the phone app exists: the shop name, colour and logo cannot be set on the laptop yet. Also choose the real shop or company name (it fixes the data folder; ADR-0018) and send an icon if you have one.

Follow documentation/owner_runbook.md once on a real Windows laptop, end to end, and tell me what is wrong. Print a hangtag sheet, a bill and a credit note slip on a real printer and scan the tags. Tell us the printer and scanner models.
Do a restore test: restore a backup on a second computer using only the paper recovery key.
Accept or reject the SQLCipher community licence (ADR-0003 point 7).
Switch on branch protection for main and develop; require branch-policy, build-lint-test and dart-flutter-windows.
Review ADR-0003 (amended twice: owner-only write-off and GST), ADR-0006, ADR-0013, ADR-0014 and ADR-0018 (Proposed).
Not built, say if you want them next: GST reports, an owner password reset, the shop name on the laptop, Release 2 (second counter, phone app).
